package.name: growmate_voice
package.description: GrowMate voice controller for the AURA FarmBot ROS2 stack. Drop-in replacement for keyboard_controller. Takes speech (or text), uses an on-device LLM to classify intent, constructs an inspectable behaviour tree, validates safety per node, and publishes the resulting commands to keyboard_topic. Includes a Gradio web app for end-to-end audio control.
